intro: Perfect for compact homes, the Alina bed combines comfort and convenience. A soft upholstered headboard and hidden storage make your room feel cozy, organized, and always ready for restful nights.

features.title: Upholstered headboard for cozy evenings
features.text: Lean back against the padded headboard wrapped in synthetic leather, giving you a soft, supportive surface for reading or relaxing.

features.title: Hidden storage for daily ease
features.text: Box storage with handle and a pull-out drawer simplify access to bedding and essentials, keeping your room clutter-free.

features.title: Durable engineered wood build
features.text: Crafted in 17 mm particle board, with a sturdy frame and partitions designed to endure daily family use with ease.

features.title: Easy transport and assembly
features.text: Knockdown construction arrives flat-packed, so shifting homes or refreshing layouts is simple, without sacrificing strength.

features.title: Walnut finish with versatile charm
features.text: The walnut tone gives a warm, modern touch, blending into both minimalist and traditional bedroom styles.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
